subject: CAIQ evidence staging: clarification on control attachments and sample windows
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ evidence staging: initial plan and asks

Team —

Quick kickoff for Clearmind’s CAIQ submission. They want a compact package we can hand off to their security reviewers by next week. I pulled together a first-pass control map (attached) and an evidence manifest with proposed sampling windows. Goal: get alignment on which artifacts we can provide as full extracts, which need redaction, and which we will provide as attested examples + runtime log snippets.

Primary asks from me:
- Kimberly: confirm ownership and whether the runtime trace examples for runtime controls (A.2 / RTE-3 etc.) can be redacted to remove PII before export. If not, note the minimal fields we need to keep for traceability.
- Marissa: please stage the attachments listed in the manifest and flag any items that require legal signoff (e.g., third-party telemetry providers).
- Soojin: I’ll need one SME for a 30-min sync with Clearmind to walk their auditor through our control mapping. Can you prep the talking points and availability?

Attachments:
- caiq_control_map_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- evidence_manifest_2027-07-26.pdf (manifest with proposed sampling windows)

Thanks — I’d like to send the package to Clearmind on Thursday EOD unless there are blockers.

—Jordan
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence staging: initial plan and asks

Thanks Jordan — I reviewed the manifest and started staging. Two quick notes:

1) Evidence availability: most infra-level proof (IAM role snapshots, network ACLs, KMS access logs) are ready for export from the evidence vault. I’ve flagged them in the manifest as "full artifact".
2) Vendor telemetry: we use TelemetryWave for runtime sampling and they require a third-party addendum for certain log extracts. I’ve added a comment on row 42 of the workbook. Legal will likely need to approve sending raw TelemetryWave extracts.

I attached a slimmed export list (internal filename: evidence_manifest_2027-07-26.pdf) and a staging checklist. I can take the lead on packaging and uploading to your Drive link.

Attachment (stub): evidence_manifest_2027-07-26.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)

If we plan to send by Thursday, I recommend we:
- Lock the manifest by Wednesday 11:00 PT
- Run a single redaction pass on any runtime traces flagged as PII-sensitive
- Prep a one-page control narrative for the auditor focusing on our prefix-KV caching and model isolation controls (I will draft)

Marissa
Sr. Security Program Manager


From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence staging: initial plan and asks

Jordan / Marissa — quick technical clarifications on the control mapping spreadsheet:

- Control CC-RTE-3 (runtime traceability): we can provide a 48-hour sampling window of runtime traces with sensitive columns redacted. The redaction script retains a hashed request id and timestamp so the auditor can verify chain-of-custody. I marked the mapping sheet with "redactable" for the affected rows.
- Control CC-CRP-1 (change control/process): deployment diff snapshots are available (git diffs + deployment pipelines). We should include pipeline run IDs and the most recent merged PRs for the sampled window.

One risk: TelemetryWave’s terms limit sharing of full raw traces; they will accept redacted extracts for audit purposes but require a usage report instead of raw logs for anything older than 30 days. That means for their data we either:
  a) provide redacted 48-hour extracts (preferred), or
  b) provide the TelemetryWave usage report + attestation that raw logs exist under their contract (requires vendor signoff).

I’ll prepare the redaction script run and a short readme. If Legal confirms third-party sharing is ok, we can include the raw extracts in the package; otherwise we’ll default to the redacted route.

—Kimberly
Principal Cloud Security Engineer


From: Alice Green <alice.g@clearmindhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@clearmindhealth.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 10:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence staging: initial plan and asks

Jordan / team — thank you for the quick coordination. A couple of clarifications from our side before you send the package: 

1) Sampling windows: can you confirm the exact UTC windows you propose for the 48-hour runtime trace samples? Our auditor needs explicit start/end times and timezone-normalized timestamps in the extracts.
2) Redaction: acceptable — we need an index that documents what was redacted and the hashing approach used for any request identifiers so it can be reproduced. A short attestation from your engineering lead confirming the hashing method is needed.
3) TelemetryWave: we prefer option (a) redacted extracts. Please include the vendor usage report as a supplemental artifact if possible.

One more ask: do you have a brief attestation doc (PDF) from your infra team confirming retention periods for ephemeral KV caches and any fallback storage? That will help close CC-RTE-7.

If you can get the artifacts to us by Friday morning our auditor can start ingesting them and we will aim for the review call next Tuesday.

Thanks,
Alice
Security Operations Manager
Clearmind Health


From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Green <alice.g@clearmindhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 29 Jul 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ evidence staging: initial plan and asks

Alice — thanks for the specifics. Summary / next steps:

- Sampling windows (UTC): proposed 2027-07-20T00:00:00Z to 2027-07-22T00:00:00Z for the 48-hour runtime trace sample. We will include the timezone-normalized columns in the extract.
- Redaction index: Kimberly will attach the redaction index and a short hashing attestation.
- TelemetryWave: Marissa will include the vendor usage report as supplemental artifact and mark any artifacts that require vendor signoff.
- Attestation for KV cache retention: I will coordinate a 1-page attestation from Infra (expected by Thursday).

We’ll upload the package to the Drive link below and send DocuSign for any owner attestations that require signature. Please treat the Drive folder as time-limited — we will set a 30-day access window.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcD_evidence_manifest
DocuSign (attestations): https://www.docusign.com/clearmind/attestations/12345

If all good, plan to send Thursday EOD (PT) and notify Alice when upload completes.

—Jordan
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
